Chapter 581: Chapter 21 Divine Lattice (Please Subscribe)_2

Lin Yuan was inherently an “elder”, fully capable of dealing with Hunyi.

…

Ocean of Light.

Within a vast, winding palace.

A gathering of True Gods convened here.

In the Ocean of Light, the twelve Prime Gods of Light reigned supreme, holding sway over certain rules and authorities.

...

The rest of the divine hosts were ranked according to their realms of power and types of faith, divided into Lower-Rank Gods, Middle-Rank Gods, and Upper-Rank Gods.

At this moment, the True Gods gathered here included eighteen Lower-Rank Gods and one Middle-Rank God.

“This is preposterous, utterly preposterous.”

“They even dare to steal the ‘Divine Crystals’ bestowed by us!!”

“It seems that the Evil Gods of the mortal realm have forgotten our divine majesty.”

…..

The True Gods were filled with anger, as over the years, the churches they had established had their accumulations of Divine Crystals progressively plundered.

Although their churches were not on par with the Main God Church, which had Demigod-level combat power on standby for defense, they were not easy to rob.

Those capable of such a feat must be at least of the Demigod level, and a very powerful one at that.

Because the churches that had their Divine Crystals plundered were not limited to these few gods, but were merely the first to convene.

There were many more True Gods who were asleep and unaware of such incidents.

“What should we do now?”

“The ones who stole the Divine Crystals were extremely cautious and careful, leaving no clues behind.”

“Moreover, what do those Evil Gods gain by stealing Divine Crystals? What’s the benefit?”

A True God expressed doubt, questioning why those level-seven Demigods weren’t gathering faith instead of stealing Divine Crystals?

The essence of Divine Crystals was a pure energy aggregation formed by True Gods using their Divine Kingdoms over long periods.

It was used to support the energy needed for their divine presence to descend to the mortal realm or to maintain the operation of the Divine Kingdoms.

The Demigods, already residing in the mortal realm and having no Divine Kingdoms to support, what was the point in seizing so many Divine Crystals?

“Regardless of the motive, brazenly plundering our churches is a provocation. I suggest we investigate immediately with utmost effort.”

“Yes, we need to find out which Evil God is responsible. I will extract his soul and burn it in the Divine Kingdom for ten thousand years.”

…

The many True Gods spoke in icy tones, their dignity since ascending to the Ocean of Light and establishing Divine Kingdoms had never been so violated.

“I will have my followers unite with other Demigods to clarify this matter.”

Just then, the only Middle-Rank God among them spoke up. Under the constraints of the twenty-four Prime Gods, these True Gods could not personally descend to the mortal realm.

As for descension through divine incarnations? Maintaining a divine incarnation required a large amount of Divine Crystals, and conducting such a time-consuming investigation couldn’t always rely on divine incarnations.

The purpose of a divine incarnation was to settle matters conclusively, such as identifying the key perpetrator behind the multiple church raids, whereupon they would then send a divine incarnation to suppress directly.

Thus, deploying Demigods to investigate this matter was the best choice.

Many Demigods in the mortal realm allied themselves with churches, but only those associated with powerful churches.

…

Longshan Ling.

Underground cultivation room.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged.

Within his mind, the Door to the Myriad Realms faintly glimmered.

A greyish-green gourd slowly emerged from the Door to the Myriad Realms, crossing infinite dimensions, descending into this world.

Also, a ‘bell-shaped’ weapon was transmitted through the Door to the Myriad Realms, arriving along with the greyish-green gourd into Lin Yuan’s hands.

Now that he had restored his power to its peak period, possessing the ability to defend himself in this universe, Lin Yuan naturally summoned the Mysterious Gourd.

By absorbing the liquid within the Mysterious Gourd, he could continuously enhance both the base size and strength of his Inner World and physical body.

Furthermore, it could enhance his Physical Body Divine Ability ‘Blood Rebirth.’

A higher level of ‘Blood Rebirth’ allowed Lin Yuan to absorb the liquid in the Mysterious Gourd not from the beginning but to quickly catch up to the most recent progress.

Just as in the Main World Prime Universe, Lin Yuan was already close to completely absorbing the blue liquid within the Mysterious Gourd.

In this world, Lin Yuan could achieve complete absorption of the blue liquid within a short period, from half a month to a few months.

By the same logic, it can be concluded that if Lin Yuan in this world had completely absorbed the sixth type of liquid, the blue liquid, from the Mysterious Gourd.

Then the original Lin Yuan in the Main World would be able to achieve this progress swiftly as well.

The two are equivalent to synchronization of realms.

Besides the Mysterious Gourd, that ‘bell-shaped’ treasure was naturally the Origin Fine Gold.

Origin Fine Gold possessed terrifying growth potential, but it required a significant amount of time to nurture.

In the Main World, Lin Yuan’s cultivation speed was simply too fast, with hardly any worlds to nurture, only striving in the shuttle worlds.

After all, carrying these two treasures into the shuttle worlds merely consumed two strands of World-Breaking Origin Force, and with Lin Yuan’s current wealth of over a hundred strands, it was completely sustainable.

…

Time passed.

In the blink of an eye, another two to three years had gone by.

“Finally…”

Lin Yuan’s consciousness descended into his Inner World, which at this moment was vast and expansive, approaching a size of nearly two billion miles in diameter.

To be precise, it was one point six six five billion miles.

Compared to the original size of ten million miles, it had grown sixteen point six five times.

That was the total increase brought about after completely absorbing the green liquid.

The Mysterious Gourd contained seven types of liquids, with the blue liquid and the purple liquid following the green liquid.

“Blue liquid.”

Lin Yuan inverted the Mysterious Gourd, its spout pointing downward, as a drop of deep blue liquid slowly formed.

“What exactly forms this liquid?” Lin Yuan observed carefully, as at his current level, he could see through numerous spatial layers at a glance.

But he was still somewhat puzzled about the nature of the blue liquid, even when magnified millions of times, the blue liquid remained just that – blue.

Unchanged.

This was quite incredible, as any object, when magnified millions of times, would show a different microscopic pattern, presenting more detailed components.

But the blue liquid… seemed to have no microscopic nor macroscopic form.

In fact, not just the blue liquid, even the initial red liquid was the same.

“Whatever, as long as it benefits me, the principle behind it will become clear later.” Lin Yuan pondered for a moment before he started to absorb the blue liquid.

Boom.

As soon as the blue liquid entered his body, a terrifying blue flame ignited, and with the help of the ‘Blood Rebirth’ Divine Skill, Lin Yuan barely held on for a while before his body turned to ashes, only to recondense and come back to life afterward.

…

Unaware.

Lin Yuan had already been the family head of the Longshan family for a hundred years.

During these hundred years, the Longshan family had developed rapidly, especially twenty years ago when the imperial family of the Slan Empire openly granted substantial favors to the Longshan family, elevating their noble rank directly to Earl.

It is known that outside of wartime, the promotion of a noble rank is extremely difficult; the imperial family is not foolish, for the more Earls there are, the less power and territory they themselves hold.

The territory of Earl Longshan encompassed the lands of several surrounding Viscounts as well as other vacant lands, reaching five billion miles in diameter, nearly ten times that of the original sixty million miles.

Furthermore, Martial Tao Cultivation Skill had already spread even further, accompanied by being the first widespread practice in the Slan Empire.

Other empires followed suit, at least the strong within these empires repeatedly studied and found no pitfalls in Martial Tao Cultivation Skill.

With no pitfalls and a cultivation method that could achieve the effects of almost all knight cultivation methods, why not promote it?

The later it was promoted, the more knights the already popular empires would produce each day, lagging step-by-step, which would eventually impact the strength of the nation.

Of course.

The proliferation of Martial Tao Cultivation Skill made countless strong individuals across the Plateau of Myriad Nations curious about Earl Longshan of Longshan Ling, from whom the Martial Tao Cultivation Skill had originated.

Many Demigods turned their gaze towards Longshan Ling.

…

Outside Longshan Ling, from a corner shadow stepped out a gaunt old man.

This old man, whose aura was contained, had a hooked nose and gloomy eyes, looking towards the distant Longshan Ling.

As a Demigod who had ignited the divine fire, he had lived nearly a hundred thousand years, experiencing countless events, thus few things could arouse his interest anymore.

“Earl Longshan, full name Longshan Yuan, the spreader of Martial Tao Cultivation Skill, this cultivation skill I have seen is intricately detailed, far beyond what mere knights of the fourth or fifth level might create.”

“This Earl Longshan has a big secret!”

The gaunt old man’s figure swiftly blurred, turning into an almost invisible shadow, and stealthily entered Longshan Ling.
